name: Untitled Skill Upgrade Game [BETA]
desc:
⚠️ ATTENTION: This game is currently in BETA and made fully by me. You may encounter unfinished stuff and bugs, please report any issues you find! ⚠️

Gain +1 Skill Point every second and become stronger than ever! ⚡
Upgrade your stats to crush everything in your path! 💪
Defeat mobs to earn Skill Points and unlock new areas with Rebirths! 🌎
Can you reach the top and become the ultimate fighter? 🔥

✨CODES: starT000, VISITS200K and 4 secret codes...✨

👍 Give the game a thumbs up if you enjoyed it! 😅

💬 Join our community server to be the first to hear about updates, sneak peeks, and more!
🐛 Found a bug? Report it on our community server or Roblox group. I appreciate your help!
⚠️Any exploits or bug abusing will result a ban of your account.⚠️

Heavily inspired by ESA1SP by GiTcHeD Games
